# Bitcoin Core ASMap tools

These files are vendored verbatim from
[Bitcoin Core](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin) at commit
`19b0ff2fa0500b7ab71ae60080c1daf98d722270` (2026-09-07).

| Local file | Upstream file |
| --- | --- |
| `asmap.py` | `contrib/asmap/asmap.py` |
| `asmap-tool.py` | `contrib/asmap/asmap-tool.py` |
| `COPYING` | `COPYING` |

See the [upstream ASMap documentation](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/19b0ff2fa0500b7ab71ae60080c1daf98d722270/contrib/asmap/README.md).
